text: Since cardiac and orthostatic causes seem unlikely, I suspect a vagal response triggered by the act of urination itself. Was your bladder exceptionally full when this incident occurred, and do you have any history of fainting in response to pain, needle sticks, or emotional stress?

text: Since cardiac and typical vasovagal causes are unlikely, I must consider neurological events that can present with rapid recovery. Did you experience any rhythmic jerking of your limbs, eye deviation, or unusual automatisms like lip-smacking during the episode?
